fields.name: patentId
fields.description: Patent ID. At least one of patentId and patentNumber must be provided; if both are present, patentId takes priority. Only a single value is supported; multiple values separated by commas are not allowed. Max length: 60000 characters

fields.name: patentNumber
fields.description: Publication (grant) number. At least one of patentId and patentNumber must be provided; if both are present, patentId takes priority. Only a single value is supported; multiple values separated by commas are not allowed. Max length: 60000 characters

fields.name: lang
fields.description: Translation language, supports en (English, default), cn (Chinese), jp (Japanese). Max length: 1000 characters

fields.name: replaceByRelated
fields.description: Whether to substitute with a family patent's description when the description is unavailable: 1 Yes, 0 No (default 0)
